test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

The officer made me to type the letter again.
solution:
the correct answer is **"to type"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Remove **to** from the sentence.
 
• The infinitive is used without to after certain verbs like** bid, let, make, see, hear, need, dare** etc.
 
• There is a problem with **to+infinitive**, some words **don't take** to with infinitive:
 
 
• The infinitive is used without to after certain **verbs like bid, let, make, see, hear, need, dare** etc.
 
 
• He made me do this work. **(correct)**
 
• He made me to do this work. **(incorrect)**
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *The officer **made **me type the letter again.*
